_comment: RAD18 combine quality gate: output quality with R3_MOE_WORKER_COMBINE=1 (helper 0 adds both helpers' bf16 rows on the CPU and writes the sum as fp16) against the same helper layout with the combine off, scored by radiance KL mode through ab-benchmark --server-config (quality_only). Both arms run the helper layout, so the control is combine0 and the gate is the combine's own change. Arm settings mirror helper-kld.json's helper-on arm; MAX_ROWS=64 with --max-num-batched-tokens 64 sends every step through the helpers' large lane, where the combine runs. Reference: the two-XTX tp 2 exact-wire run recorded once (2026-10-23) into KLD_REF_DIR=${BC_WORK_ROOT}/runs/rad18-kld/reference with helper-kld.json's record block; restore that block to re-record into a new directory. Set RAD_BIN, RAD_HOME, R9700_BDF, KLD_REF_DIR. Retire with helper-combine-nofire-ab.json once the gate is decided. KL mode runs 64-row steps and the combine fires only at R3_MOE_WORKER_COMBINE_MIN_ROWS (default 256), so the combine1 arm sets it to 1: every step goes through the combine. Check 'combine steps N' > 0 in helper0.log after the run (the first run, 2026-10-23, never fired and its identical result was void). History: a bf16 sum failed this gate (p99 +0.275 against 0.2), and an engine-side rounding-only control (since removed) matched it exactly, so the loss was the bf16 rounding; the sum is now fp16.
